exposure: Intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) vs. natural conception
cohort: 291 women who achieved a successful pregnancy by ICSI and 466 women with normal pregnancies
finding: Women who conceived through ICSI had similar rates of fetal malformations but higher rates of cesarean section, multiple gestations, lower birth weight infants, gestational diabetes, antepartum hemorrhage, and preterm labor compared to women with normal pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women with ICSI had significantly higher rates of cesarean section compared to women with normal pregnancies.
birth_weight: Neonates born from ICSI pregnancies were lower in birthweight
